title: Common definitions
description: Shared primitives and enums. Contract v1.1 (ADR-001, ADR-004).

utc_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC, must end in Z. Offsets are rejected so every stored time is unambiguous. The pattern enforces shape; format enforces a real calendar date and time, so validators must enable format checking.

decimal_string.description: Exact decimal as a string. Never a float.

date.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. v1.1. format rejects impossible dates such as 2026-02-30.

money_string.description: Computed money, rounded half-even to cents at serialization only. v1.1.

weight_string.description: Computed share as a fraction (0.488000 is 48.8%), rounded half-even to six places at serialization only. v1.1.

unavailable_reason.description: Why a computed value is missing. Missing is never zero. v1.1.

amount.description: A deterministic money calculation with its basis, or the reason it is unavailable. Never model output. v1.1.

weight_amount.description: A deterministic share calculation with its basis, or the reason it is unavailable. Never model output. v1.1.

surface_status.description: Shared UI state. Empty coverage is not no_material_change.

research_action.description: Research actions only. Never a trade instruction.

horizon.description: Supported horizons. Intraday is excluded until feeds and latency are established.

feed.description: Always explicit; never rely on a subscription-dependent default.
